# Question: generator-shortcuts

> For this generator, name the strongest plausible shortcut or rival rule that
> fits the canonical demonstrations. Give an exact input on which it disagrees
> with the intended rule, how you checked the output, and whether your proposed
> generator emits such cases.

The strongest concrete shortcut found in review is **`bottommost_lr`**:
segment same-color four-connected components, keep components whose tight raw
bbox is left-right symmetric and wider than one, then return the eligible
component whose bottom row is lowest. It fits all **8/8 labeled canonical pairs**
but ignores the intended occupied-cell maximization.

A current default-generator counterexample is `difficulty="easy"`, seed `0`,
`sample_index=0`, no overrides:

```text
[
  [0,5,5,0,0,0,0,0,0,0],
  [5,5,5,5,0,0,9,0,0,0],
  [0,0,0,0,0,9,9,9,0,6],
  [6,6,0,0,0,0,9,0,0,6],
  [6,6,6,0,0,0,0,0,0,6],
  [6,6,6,0,0,0,0,0,0,6],
  [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,6],
  [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,6],
  [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,6],
  [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,6]
]
```

The intended rule selects the six-cell color-5 component and returns:

```text
[[0,5,5,0],
 [5,5,5,5]]
```

The positional shortcut selects the lower five-cell color-9 cross and returns:

```text
[[0,9,0],
 [9,9,9],
 [0,9,0]]
```

I checked the intended output with the supported public command
`arcpuzzles apply`, not a Python label mirror. Its retained receipt is
`checks/selected/bottommost-racket.json`; it records final generator SHA-256
`b012fe138cc2497dc1615e75815a0fc1f05cb5577e5f162cfc942702f8ec685f`,
executed rule hash `9d224076bec5`, matching catalog authority, and the exact
input/output hashes. The combined compact witness is
`repo/generators/e521d16d403e/counterexamples/bottommost-lr-repair-witness.json`.

**Yes, the proposed production generator emits such disagreement cases on
purpose.** Profiles 0 and 2 put a smaller eligible component below the true
winner. In the tested four-profile schedule, every four-pair window contains two
such refutations, so any one held-out query leaves at least one in the three
demonstrations. The task-local exhaustive check found the shortcut refuted in
48/48 production windows and 192/192 one-query rotations; the independent
300-lesson census found no surviving declared rival. These finite checks do not
rule out undeclared shortcuts.
